name: Sam
look: Sam, age 41, slim build with narrow shoulders and a lean neck (not muscular); oval face, straight brows, blue-grey eyes, slightly upturned nose, small closed-mouth smile, clean-shaven, fair skin with a warm undertone; short medium-brown hair, short at the sides with a textured 4-5 cm top falling slightly forward and a few grey strands at the temples (never swept back or a pompadour); plain charcoal crewneck knit sweater, slim dark trousers, white running sneakers

rows.label: stance, crouch and guard
poses: fighting stance: side-on, knees bent, rear fist by the chin, lead fist forward at shoulder height
dropping into a crouch, knees half bent
full crouch, low on bent knees, fists up guarding the face
standing block: forearms raised in front of the face, chin tucked, braced
crouching block: low crouch with forearms crossed in front of the face

rows.label: jump
poses: jump take-off: deep knee bend, arms swinging down, about to spring
rising jump: body stretched upward, legs trailing, arms up
jump apex: knees tucked to the chest, fists guarding
falling: legs extending down to land, arms out for balance
landing: knees absorbing the impact, low, fists up

rows.label: light punch (jab)
poses: fighting stance
lead fist snapping forward, elbow half extended
jab fully extended straight forward at head height, shoulder rolled in
fist retracting back toward guard

rows.label: heavy punch (straight cross)
poses: fighting stance
wind-up: rear fist pulled back, hips coiled
rear straight cross fully extended forward at head height, hips and shoulders rotated, rear heel lifted
follow-through: arm still extended, weight forward
recovering back toward guard

rows.label: light kick (front kick)
poses: fighting stance
front knee chambered up to the waist
fast front snap kick extended forward at waist height, toes pointing forward
leg retracting, knee chambered

rows.label: heavy kick (roundhouse)
poses: fighting stance
pivot on the front foot, rear knee raised and turned over
high roundhouse kick fully extended forward at head height, body leaning back for balance
kicking leg sweeping through, still high
leg coming down, returning to stance

rows.label: crouching light (crouch jab)
poses: deep crouch, knees fully bent, fists up guarding
still in the deep crouch, lead fist punching straight forward at waist height
deep crouch, fist pulling back to guard

rows.label: crouching heavy (low sweep)
poses: full crouch, fists up
dropping lower, one hand touching the ground, spinning
low leg sweep: one leg fully extended forward along the ground, body very low, hand on the floor
sweep finishing, rising back to a crouch

low.note: Every frame in BOTH rows is a LOW CROUCHING pose: knees deeply bent, hips low, head at about two thirds of standing height; never standing upright.

rows.label: jumping kick
poses: airborne with knees tucked
flying kick: front leg extended diagonally forward and down, rear leg tucked, arms guarding
flying kick held, fully extended
leg retracting back into a tuck in the air

rows.label: throw
poses: fighting stance
lunging forward, both hands reaching forward at chest height to grab
both hands gripping an invisible opponent's collar, pulling close, knee rising
turning the hips and heaving both arms over the shoulder in a throw
finishing the throw, arms swung down, then upright

rows.label: special 1: compute blast (projectile)
poses: fighting stance
both hands cupped together at the hip gathering a small glowing cyan energy ball
both palms thrust forward at chest height, a bright cyan energy burst leaving the hands
arms still extended forward, fading cyan sparks on the palms
pulling the hands back to guard

rows.label: special 2: scaling rush (dashing elbow)
poses: fighting stance
low lean forward, about to dash, cyan glow on the lead elbow
dashing forward horizontally, lead elbow driving forward at chest height, rear leg trailing
elbow strike at full extension, body low and forward
braking and recovering to stance

rows.label: special 3: launch uppercut (rising)
poses: fighting stance
crouching low, rear fist cocked at the hip with cyan glow
leaping upward with a rising uppercut, fist high above the head, body stretched, feet off the ground
apex of the rising uppercut, fist straight up, knees bent in the air
landing in a crouch

rows.label: back dash
poses: fighting stance
hopping backward: body leaning back, feet leaving the ground, fists guarding
airborne backward hop, legs together slightly bent
landing on the balls of the feet, knees bent, fists guarding

rows.label: super move part 1
poses: fighting stance
powering up: fists clenched at the sides, chest out, cyan aura around the hands
rushing jab, lead fist extended, glowing cyan
rushing cross, rear fist extended, glowing cyan

rows.label: super move part 2
poses: spinning back kick at chest height
both palms thrust forward releasing a large bright cyan energy beam
beam sustained, palms forward, body braced, hair blown back
relaxing back into the fighting stance

rows.label: hit high
poses: fighting stance
struck in the face: head snapped back, torso leaning back, arms flung loose
staggering back half a step, wincing, guard dropping

rows.label: hit low
poses: fighting stance
struck in the stomach: doubled over forward, arms around the waist
staggering, hunched, recovering

rows.label: knockdown
poses: struck hard: thrown backward off the feet, body arched back in the air
falling backward through the air, legs up, back toward the ground
hitting the ground on the back, bouncing slightly
lying flat on the back on the ground, head to the left, feet to the right

rows.label: get up
poses: lying flat on the back on the ground, head to the left, feet to the right
sitting up, propped on one hand
kneeling on one knee, pushing up
rising to the feet
back in the fighting stance

rows.label: KO (defeated)
poses: dazed and swaying, arms limp
knees buckling, head dropping
on both knees, slumped forward
collapsed lying on the stomach on the ground, head to the right

rows.label: victory
poses: fighting stance
relaxing, straightening up, dusting off the sweatshirt
confident smile, adjusting the sweatshirt sleeves
victory pose: one fist raised high in the air, other hand on the hip, smiling

rows.label: intro
poses: standing relaxed, hands in pockets, calm smile
taking the hands out of the pockets, rolling the shoulders
cracking the knuckles in front of the chest
pointing a finger forward at the opponent with a confident look
settling into the fighting stance

rows.label: tag in
poses: leaping in from behind, airborne, body leaning forward, knees tucked
landing in a low three-point crouch, one hand on the ground
rising from the crouch
back in the fighting stance, ready

outfit: plain charcoal crewneck knit sweater, slim dark trousers, white sneakers
